chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام that he said:

Indeed, there is an angel appointed over the graves. So when the family of the deceased departs from their funeral, away from their dead one, he takes a handful of soil and casts it into their tracks, then says: Forget what you have seen. Were it not for that, no one would benefit from living.

key_terms.مَلَكًا: an angelic being appointed by Allah
key_terms.مُوَكَّلًا: assigned or entrusted with a specific duty

ai.seo_question: Why do people gradually move on after burying a loved one according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes an angel appointed over the graves who causes the bereaved to forget the full impact of what they witnessed at burial. It points to a divine mercy in human life: without some veiling of grief and death’s stark reality, people would not be able to continue living and functioning.
